eventHandlers.description: All registered event handlers on this EventSource that should be serialized with state.

nonSerializableEventHandlers.description: All registered event handlers on this EventSource that should NOT be serialized with state.

title:
An "event source" manages handlers that listen for changes to an object. This follows the conventions of many
UI frameworks that define `on` to register a handler function. This type manages the list of handlers and dispatching
events to them. To register a callback use #on with an event name and handler function. When called, your handler
will be called with `this` equal to the instance that triggered the event.
name: UiEventSource
